Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine

Interface AIiActionExecutionService

public interface AIiActionExecutionService
Technical worker execution capacity owned by the ActionExecutionEngine. The service does not own domain actions, transaction journals or commit semantics. Submitted workers must not block waiting to acquire provider execution resources.
